class.name: NetwDisplaySpecRow
class.brief_description: One display channel as the authoring registry declares it, before anything is built.
class.description: The session builds an entity's display by asking what that entity declares, and the answer is a list of these. A row names WHERE a value comes from, WHERE it is shown, and HOW it is smoothed, and it names nothing else: it holds no history, no port and no runtime, because a declaration outlives every channel built from it. Two shapes, and the difference is whether anything is sampled. [codeblock] of_property(node, "position", spec) # sampled from node.position each frame of_argument(node, spec) # written when an event carries it [/codeblock] A property row's [member target_prop] is the spec's [member NetwInterpolate.target] when one is set and the source property otherwise, so redirecting a channel with [code].to()[/code] is a property of the spec rather than of the caller. An argument row has no [member source_prop] at all, because an event argument arrives rather than being read. Rows are answered by the session's spec reader and consumed immediately, so a row that names a freed node is dropped rather than repaired.

method.name: is_displayable
method.description: Whether this row can become a channel: it names a live [member node], a non-empty [member target_prop], and a spec that actually smooths something. A spec in [constant NetwInterpolate.MODE_NONE] declares a value tracked for other reasons and displayed by nobody, which is why it is a row that exists and does not build.

method.name: of_argument
method.description: A row for a value that arrives on an RPC or signal argument. It takes [member target_prop] from the spec's [member NetwInterpolate.target] and has no source, so the channel built from it writes and never samples.

method.name: of_property
method.description: A row for a property sampled on [param node]. [member target_prop] is the spec's [member NetwInterpolate.target] when it is set, and [param source_prop] otherwise.

members.member: The node this row is declared on, held by id rather than by reference: the scene owns it, and a row must not keep a freed subtree alive.
The property sampled on [member node], or empty for an argument row. Emptiness is what distinguishes the two shapes.
How the value is smoothed between the samples that reach it.

The property the smoothed value is written to. Equal to [member source_prop] for a channel that smooths a value in place, and different for one redirected with [code].to()[/code] or aimed at a visual root.
